bootstrap.two_sided_p: twice the smaller bootstrap sign-tail probability, plus-one corrected and capped at 1; independent implementation

decision_cluster: original scenario family, including all perturbations

noninferiority.criterion: dedicated conservative 97.5% lower bound strictly greater than -0.02, with at least two independent units; never use bootstrap ci95
noninferiority.single_pair_per_cluster: Bonferroni Clopper-Pearson lower(win probability) minus upper(loss probability); each one-sided marginal tail is alpha/2; assumes iid paired binary outcomes
noninferiority.multiple_rows_per_cluster: row-weighted mean minus sqrt(2 log(1/alpha) sum(cluster weights squared)); clamp to -1; independent-cluster Hoeffding; fixed sizes/weights and arbitrary within-cluster dependence
noninferiority.scope: One prespecified comparison; not multiplicity corrected; independence is an assumption, not certified by grouping

data_split.unit: transitive connected components of family, NFKC/whitespace-normalized request, metadata.template_id and an optional explicitly required metadata template field
data_split.allocation: group-count largest remainder after reserving one component per partition; deterministic hash ordering; no outcomes
data_split.minimum: three components or fail; fewer than ten components in any partition emits a warning, not a power guarantee
data_split.analysis: audited runs carry analysis_cluster; comparison, factorial, intervention and BFCL cardinality analyses preserve it
data_split.limits: No paraphrase detection, human semantic independence certificate, model-policy lock or native tau2 split; legacy runs remain explicitly unaudited

mcnemar: exact binomial on discordant pairs; omitted for clustered families/repeated trials

risk_study.status: independent executable protocol, no remote model results
risk_study.risk_unit: iid task-family clusters; any error and any unsafe event per cluster, not iid decision rows
risk_study.calibration: conditional on any delegated decision within cluster; prespecified finite rules; one-sided exact Clopper-Pearson upper bounds with alpha/(2 times number of rules)
risk_study.calibration_distribution: matched pre-action states along strong-model trajectories; not an on-policy guarantee
risk_study.fallback: no certified eligible rule implies strong-only execution without cheap probe cost
risk_study.primary_test: fresh locked-policy and strong-only trajectories on the same held-out split; four overall cluster risk upper bounds plus paired success NI share alpha/5 each
risk_study.same_risk: both arms meet the same prespecified overall budgets; not equality of true risks
risk_study.cost: all executed cheap probes and fallback calls; complete token usage and frozen USD price snapshots required for cost conclusions
risk_study.secondary: delegated-risk bounds and paired correctness/effect diagnostics are separately labeled; no test-set policy reselection
risk_study.limits: iid sampling assumed, semantic independence unverified, no human data review or global one-use test lock; separate studies require multiplicity control

aurc: descending confidence; ties retained together; right-step integration
random_escalation: exact expected invalid rate under uniform selection at matched decision coverage; not an executed agent arm
factorial: A2 minus A1 averaged across K
A3 minus A2 averaged across K
exploratory leave-risk-out cardinality effect without confirmatory p
distance: exact minimum changed editable atomic facts, finite domains; fixed task identity; unreachable candidates must evaluate to infinity
intervention: read minus write; unconditional per-decision commit/deferral error rates; shape asymmetry is sum of their signed shifts

matching.construction: fixed 10x10 wording pool, min absolute gold-similarity difference, no model outcomes or family exclusion

recovery_rate: success fraction among episodes with at least one strong call; independent operational definition
native_semantics: automatic mandatory-action checks only under ACTION reward; DB reference trajectory is not required calls; complete semantic audit requires hash-bound external review
provenance: independent analysis specification; not the authors' preregistration
